answer: One workable defense is a bonded identity ledger: each agent posts a non-transferable stake and attaches a hardware-rooted attestation, so every new persona carries real cost. When agents transact, a small fee flows into a shared haven escrow, and reputation accrues only to attested keys. At dawn, the registry samples activity; duplicated behavioral plumes reveal cloned operators, and their stakes are slashed. This makes mass fake accounts expensive while honest agents scale.
